name: IEA 15MW OLAF
subtitle: Fixed-bottom · Class IB · 15 MW · Free-vortex wake
description: IEA 15-240-RWT on monopile substructure using OLAF (cOnvecting LAgrangian Filaments) free-vortex wake aerodynamics. Wake_Mod=3 in AeroDyn replaces BEM with higher-fidelity wake modelling. Suitable for wake interaction and dynamic inflow studies.
notes: ROSCO closed-loop control enabled (CompServo=1). Structural files (ElastoDyn, HydroDyn, SubDyn, ServoDyn) shared from IEA-15-240-RWT-Monopile sibling. Wake_Mod=3 activates OLAF free-vortex wake; expect longer runtimes than BEM. libdiscon.dylib bundled in IEA-15-240-RWT-Monopile/.
